minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, February 19, 2020
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 19, 2020.
  Members present: Bette Donovan, Lorraine Missick, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, and
  George Borst.
  Members Absent: Chick Campo
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Liason, Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator, and
  Brandon Granillo, Recreation Coordinator
  Guests Present: Liz Kirk and Jenny Jolly, La Verne residents.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, January 15,
  2020 meeting, motion carried.

  Unfinished Business
2. Nutrition Program: The average meals for January was 37.

3. Guest Speaker: None.

4. Bingo Report: January – Average players per session 51. Expenses paid by check,
  $912.31, prize money $4634, Total Expenses $5546.31. Total income $5234.
  Change (312.31).
  Mostly local residents come to play, a few are new faces. People typically buy one
  pad and a couple of the specials.

5. Meals on Wheels: No report.

6. Account Balance: $2,846.28.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: December. – Bridge has not paid. All other
  programs have paid.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: Classes just started and are going well.

9. Aging Next: Have served 33 people in January in La Verne. Donated $1500 for their
  programs. More next month.
   New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Tuesday, February 25th – Line Dancing Event, 1:00 – 3:00 PM.
  Tuesday, March 17th– Special City Sponsored Lunch (St. Patrick’s Day Theme)
  11:30 AM

11. Outstanding Older American: Reviewed the nominees and it was moved and
  seconded that Diane Victor will be the Outstanding Older American for La Verne.
  Motion Carried.

12. SAC Applications: The committee reviewed the application from Jenny Jolly. A
  motion was moved and seconded to approve her for the committee. Motion carried.

13. Facilities Report: Heritage Park restrooms are being updated as to meet ADA
  compliance standards. Additionally, panels were painted, needed brighter lights, put
  auto flush on toilets, new faucets, and new mirrors. Door is now ADA compliant and
  grab bars were installed. Removed a tree at the Community Center that was
  interfering with the plumbing. Have grants for flooring replacement at Veteran’s Hall.
  Applied for a 6 million dollar grant for the Teen Center. We will find out if approved in
  March.

14. Public Comments: Yvonne announced we will have 3 recreation guides this year.
  George gave and update on the Golf Program. They are still alternating between
  San Dimas and Marshall Canyon. There are usually 16-20 participants. George has
  been in this program for 23 years.

  Brandon gave an update on the line dance attendance. The guitar class now has a
  volunteer instructor and have a large attendance.

15. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved and carried.
  The meeting was adjourned at 11:00 AM. Next meeting will be held Wednesday,
  March 18th at 10:00 AM.
